text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a magazine interview, the Trainer 
was asked about their impressions of Mr. 
C.B. They replied that she had broadened 
their world over the past year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home that day, Mr. C.B. spoke: 
Unlike other Umamusume, she couldn't bring 
herself to run for someone else's sake—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but wonder if something 
important was missing from within myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Trainer affirmed her. She 
explained that being told she had 
broadened their world gave her courage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she wasn't fond of promises, she 
made a vow: "No matter what happens, I'll 
always remain the Mr. C.B. you dream of."
